edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender.
msg.sender is used as the spender and allowance owner in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender reaches _transfer through transfer/transferFrom.
manualswap authorizes by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
_owner is initialized from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
block.timestamp controls the per-address cooldown mapping, a timestamp dependency gate.
block.timestamp is used in the cooldown comparison that gates buys.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
recipient parameter flows into the transfer logic.
amount parameter flows into the transfer logic.
sender parameter is used as the transferFrom source.
spender parameter is used in approve.
from parameter drives the blacklist, cooldown and swap branches.
to parameter drives the blacklist, cooldown and swap branches.
amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and cooldown.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input amount.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping.
notbot parameter is written into the bots mapping.
tAmount parameter feeds the reflection value computation.
maxTxAmount parameter overwrites the owner-controlled _maxTxAmount state.
contractTokenBalance local is passed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
path local is used to build the router swap call.
currentRate local scales the team reflection amount.
contractBalance local is swapped in manualswap.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and conditions hold.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee after swapping.
_transfer path leads to an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap while inSwap guard is set.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading calls the factory createPair external function.
openTrading assigns the router state variable.
openTrading assigns the pair state variable from createPair.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
aprove writes addresses into the owner-controlled bots blacklist.
delBot clears an address from the owner-controlled bots blacklist.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflected fee.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds reflection balances that can drift with rate changes.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate.
_getRate reads supply data from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2.
setCooldownEnabled owner-only toggles cooldownEnabled.
_setMaxTxAmount owner-only overwrites _maxTxAmount.
constructor sets _owner from the deployer.
constructor sets the fee wallet 1 address.
constructor sets the fee wallet 2 address that receives ETH.
_transfer ultimately reads and writes _rOwned balances.
swapTokensForEth toggles the inSwap guard flag.
The external router swap can call back into token transfer logic before inSwap state settles.
External addLiquidityETH during openTrading can re-enter token transfer paths.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is the destination parameter consumed by transfer.
amount is the value parameter consumed by transfer.
sender is the allowance source parameter consumed by transferFrom.
spender is the allowance target parameter consumed by approve.
from is the source parameter driving all _transfer branches.
to is the destination parameter driving all _transfer branches.
amountTransfer is the value parameter used in _transfer checks.
tokenAmount is the swap input parameter of swapTokensForEth.
botsArray is the blacklist input parameter of aprove.
notbot is the un-blacklist input parameter of delBot.
tAmount is the token amount parameter feeding _transferStandard math.
maxTxAmount is the new limit parameter written by _setMaxTxAmount.
contractTokenBalance is the local forwarded into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the local forwarded into sendETHToFee.
path is the local swap path built inside swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is the local rate used to scale the team amount in _takeTeam.
contractBalance is the local balance swapped by manualswap.
